basics.name: Syed Hashir Ali
basics.label: Computer Science Student · Robotics & Event Leadership
basics.summary: Computer Science student at GU Tech and two-time FIRST Global Challenge representative for Team Pakistan. Experienced in robotics, web development (Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript), AI-assisted app building, event operations, and educational outreach; enjoys turning ambitious ideas into organized, working systems with a team.

highlights: Guided prospective students on academic pathways and tracked applicant progress through the admissions pipeline.
Summarized applicant feedback, communication logs, and status updates to support faculty and management decisions.
Coordinated between applicants, professors, and university leadership to streamline outreach workflows.

work.position: Vice President, Event Operations & Branding Lead (ROBOTRON '26)
highlights: Led planning and delivery of an inter-house robotics and innovation competition for 50+ teams.
Built the event execution plan and directed branding, visual identity, and presentation standards.
Coordinated logistics, vendors, students, staff, and volunteers from setup through closing.
Led a 12-person volunteer team across two events with 450+ and 600+ attendees.
Managed entry flow, seating, and backstage logistics as on-site contact for organizers and attendees.
Supported personal branding, market research, brand strategy, and social media management.
Produced copywriting, graphic design, presentations, and video editing; assisted with LinkedIn optimization and PR.
Assisted with STEM activities, 3D modeling and printing workshops, and summer camps; managed the social media calendar.

projects.name: Recon: Month-End Reconciliation Web App
highlights: Multi-client app that imports bank, gateway, and platform statements, proves completeness, and matches sales to payments and payouts.
Exception-driven review with preparer/reviewer sign-off, period locking, and an Excel audit pack.

projects.name: MedFlow Pharmacy ERP
highlights: Multi-pharmacy ERP migrating from a Streamlit prototype to a Turborepo monorepo with web, admin, and desktop apps.
Row-level security, MFA-protected operator console, and PIN-based staff sign-in via Edge Functions.

projects.name: GUTECH LMS Portal
highlights: Full-stack learning management system with student, faculty, and admin roles, deployed on Vercel.

projects.name: WayMed: Healthcare Navigation Prototype
highlights: Design-thinking prototype with guided intake, explainable department suggestions, and indoor routing in English, Urdu, and Sindhi.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio Website
highlights: Static portfolio with a Firebase-powered blog and admin studio; this resume is generated from JSON into LaTeX and offered as a download.

projects.name: FIRST Global Challenge Robots (Team Pakistan)
highlights: Geneva 2022 (Carbon Capture): built the competition robot in three months; team reached the 8th Alliance.
Singapore 2023 (Hydrogen Horizons): represented Pakistan again, collaborating with international teams.
